alt: L’Aina i l’avi Ferran conversen durant una passejada pel parc.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one single landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536×1024, for a Catalan listening-comprehension worksheet and catalogue card, printed around 80 mm wide. Reference images specify only canonical character appearance and established drawing style. Fine naturalistic ink and softly textured muted watercolor, warm paper fading into a generous pure-white border on all four edges; no frame. Warm gentle light, restrained earthy colors. Single coherent specific scene, large readable figures and natural hands, no panels, no labels, writing, numerals, logos or watermark. Keep all reference character faces, ages and clothing consistent; do not include the lettering or layout of the model sheets. Characters: Aina, girl with straight dark chestnut bob and bangs, round glasses, mustard sweater; Ferran, smiling elderly man with wavy silver hair and short white beard, dark round glasses, charcoal cable-knit cardigan and sage checked shirt. They are standing on a quiet leafy park path during a stroll. Ferran makes a small proposing gesture and Aina listens with a playful, thoughtful expression. Frame them from the thighs up, foliage and indistinct path in the background. This must not depict the eventual picnic location. Do not show any bench, porch, canopy, shelter, wet ground, rain, puddles, food, water bottle, napkins, bags or sandwiches. No objects suggesting which person carries anything or who proposes the final place.
encoding: WebP quality 90; original composition and dimensions retained.
